mainTopic: How many guilt-offerings (אשם ודאי) a man brings for relations with a שפחה חרופה several times, and whether a period of awareness between the acts splits them into separate obligations.
overview: The amud opens by finishing עולא's ruling. A man who had relations with a שפחה חרופה five times brings only one אשם, even if he realized his sin between each act. רב המנונא objects with a man who sets aside an animal and then sins again. עולא answers that his rule never covered acts done after הפרשה. רב דימי then reports that according to the view that an אשם ודאי requires ידיעה בתחילה, the man brings an offering for each act. אביי challenges him, because רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש dispute this very question for a חטאת. רב דימי goes silent. אביי suggests he meant acts done after הפרשה, like רב המנונא, and רב דימי agrees. רבין then sums it all up in three cases: everyone agrees on one offering in עולא's case, everyone agrees on an offering for each act in רב המנונא's case, and the view requiring ידיעה falls into the dispute of רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש. The amud ends with איתמר, which opens a new dispute that continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Five acts with a שפחה חרופה require only one offering
steps.stepSummary: עולא's ruling concludes: five acts of relations with a שפחה חרופה obligate only one אשם.
steps.simpleTranslation: If a man had relations with a שפחה חרופה five times, he only has to bring one offering.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the end of עולא's statement from the previous page. According to the view that an אשם ודאי does not need ידיעה בתחילה, many acts with a שפחה חרופה require only one אשם.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For a חטאת, a period of awareness between sins can split them into separate obligations. עולא says this does not happen for an אשם, because under this view awareness plays no role in the אשם at all. So even if the man realized his sin between each act, all five acts are covered by one offering.

keyTerms.meaning: A half-slave maidservant who is designated (betrothed) to a Hebrew slave. Relations with her obligate the man in an אשם.
A 'definite' guilt-offering, brought for a sin the person certainly committed (such as the שפחה חרופה case)
He is obligated in only one (offering)

steps.confusionAlert: This line is not a brand-new statement. It is the second half of עולא's ruling, which began on the previous page with the condition 'according to the one who says an אשם ודאי does not need ידיעה בתחילה.'

phrases.english: If he had relations five times with a designated maidservant —
phrases.notes: Even with awareness of the sin between each act.

phrases.english: he is only obligated in one (offering).
phrases.notes: Because awareness does not split the obligation for an אשם.

steps.triggerLanguage: בָּעַל חָמֵשׁ בְּעִילוֹת בְּשִׁפְחָה חֲרוּפָה אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא אַחַת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes עולא's statement begun on the previous daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Under the view that an אשם ודאי does not require ידיעה בתחילה, multiple acts with a שפחה חרופה require only one אשם.

steps.title: רב המנונא objects: what about sinning after setting aside the animal?
steps.stepSummary: רב המנונא challenges עולא with a case where the man sets aside an offering and then deliberately sins again, hoping the same animal will cover it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב המנונא challenged this: If so, suppose a man had relations, did it again, set aside an animal for his offering, and said, 'Wait for me until I have relations again.' Would you also say he brings only one offering?
steps.whatsHappening: רב המנונא attacks עולא's rule by pushing it to an extreme case. If one offering covers all the acts, then a man could set aside his animal, sin again, and have the same animal cover the new sin too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The logic of the attack is that עולא's rule seems to have no limit. If awareness never splits the obligation, then even setting aside an animal should not split it. That result is absurd, because it lets a person plan new sins under an offering already set aside.

keyTerms.meaning: But if so (introduces an absurd consequence of the opponent's view)
He set aside (designated) an animal as an offering

phrases.english: Rav Hamnuna strongly objected to it:
But if so, if he had relations and again had relations,
and set aside an offering, and said:
'Wait for me until I have relations again,'
phrases.notes: He wants the animal he already set aside to cover his next sin too.

phrases.aramaic: הָכִי נָמֵי דְּאֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא אַחַת?
phrases.english: would you also say that he is only obligated in one?

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְקִיף לַהּ רַב הַמְנוּנָא אֶלָּא מֵעַתָּה
steps.kashyaTarget: עולא's rule that many acts with a שפחה חרופה require only one אשם.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Taken without limits, the rule would let an animal already set aside cover sins committed afterward, which is unreasonable.

steps.title: עולא: my rule never covered acts done after the animal was set aside
steps.stepSummary: עולא answers that his ruling applies only to acts done before an animal was set aside.
steps.simpleTranslation: עולא said to him: You are talking about an act done after the animal was set aside? I never said my rule about an act done after setting aside the animal.
steps.whatsHappening: עולא defends his rule by limiting it. It only covers sins committed before an animal was set aside.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Awareness alone does not split the obligation for an אשם. Setting aside an animal, however, does create a break. Any sin done after the הפרשה needs its own offering, so רב המנונא's case does not contradict עולא.

keyTerms.meaning: Setting aside (designating) an animal for an offering

steps.whyThisMatters: This distinction becomes the basis of רבין's later summary. Everyone agrees that acts done after הפרשה each require their own offering.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מַעֲשֶׂה דִּלְאַחַר הַפְרָשָׁה קָאָמְרַתְּ?!
phrases.english: He said to him: You are speaking of an act done after the setting aside?!
I was not speaking of an act done after the setting aside.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ מַעֲשֶׂה דִּלְאַחַר הַפְרָשָׁה קָאָמְרַתְּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רב המנונא's challenge by narrowing the case.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of the original ruling
steps.terutzHavaAmina: עולא's rule seemed to cover every act, even those done after setting aside an animal.
steps.terutzMaskana: The rule covers only acts done before הפרשה. Acts done after it each need their own offering.

steps.title: רב דימי's version: each act requires its own offering
steps.stepSummary: רב דימי reports that according to the view requiring ידיעה בתחילה for an אשם ודאי, each of the five acts needs a separate offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: When רב דימי came from ארץ ישראל, he said: According to the one who says an אשם ודאי requires ידיעה בתחילה, if a man had relations five times with a שפחה חרופה, he is obligated for each and every one.
steps.whatsHappening: A new report from ארץ ישראל gives the opposite side of עולא's statement. Under the view that an אשם needs ידיעה בתחילה, the awareness between acts splits them, so he brings five offerings.
steps.deeperAnalysis: עולא spoke about the view where awareness does not matter for an אשם. רב דימי speaks about the view where it does matter, just as it does for a חטאת. If awareness matters, then the awareness between each act separates them into five obligations.

keyTerms.meaning: When (so-and-so) came (from ארץ ישראל to בבל)
According to the one who says
Awareness at the start: the requirement that the sinner know for certain that he sinned

phrases.english: When Rav Dimi came, he said:
According to the one who says that a definite guilt-offering
requires awareness at the start,
if he had relations five times with a designated maidservant —
he is obligated for each and every one.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the matching ruling for the opposite view of אשם ודאי.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If an אשם ודאי requires ידיעה בתחילה, five acts with awareness between them require five offerings.

steps.title: אביי: even for a חטאת this question is disputed
steps.stepSummary: אביי objects that רב דימי cannot state this as a simple rule, since רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש disagree about this very issue for חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said to him: But look at a חטאת, where we do require ידיעה בתחילה, and רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש disagree about it!
steps.whatsHappening: אביי challenges רב דימי's flat statement. Even for a חטאת, which certainly requires awareness, there is a dispute about whether awareness between sins splits them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: At most, an אשם that requires ידיעה would be equal to a חטאת. Since the חטאת case itself is disputed between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש, רב דימי cannot state 'liable for each one' as if everyone agrees.

keyTerms.meaning: A sin-offering, brought for an accidental sin that carries כרת

phrases.english: Abaye said to him:
But look at a sin-offering, where we require awareness at the start,

phrases.aramaic: וּפְלִיגִי רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן לָקִישׁ!
phrases.english: and Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish disagree!
phrases.notes: They disagree about whether awareness between sins splits them into separate obligations.

steps.kashyaTarget: רב דימי's unqualified ruling that each act requires a separate offering.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An אשם requiring ידיעה can be no stricter than a חטאת. Since the חטאת case is disputed, the ruling cannot be stated without qualification.

steps.title: רב דימי is silent and אביי suggests what he meant
steps.stepSummary: רב דימי has no answer. אביי suggests he was speaking about acts done after הפרשה, like רב המנונא.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב דימי was silent. אביי said to him: Perhaps you were speaking about an act done after the animal was set aside, in line with רב המנונא?
steps.whatsHappening: רב דימי cannot answer the challenge. אביי offers a possible explanation of what רב דימי's statement really meant.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If רב דימי's case was about acts done after הפרשה, there is no conflict with the רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש dispute. Everyone agrees that each such act needs its own offering, as רב המנונא argued.

phrases.english: He (Rav Dimi) was silent.
He (Abaye) said to him: Perhaps
you were speaking of an act done after the setting aside,
in line with Rav Hamnuna?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the challenge goes unanswered, אביי proposes a reinterpretation.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether רב דימי's ruling referred to acts done after הפרשה.

steps.title: רב דימי confirms: yes
steps.stepSummary: רב דימי agrees that his statement was about acts done after הפרשה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב דימי confirms אביי's suggestion. His statement was about the case of רב המנונא, so the challenge falls away.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once רב דימי's ruling is limited to acts done after הפרשה, it no longer conflicts with the dispute about חטאת. 'Liable for each one' holds in that case according to everyone.

phrases.english: He said to him: Yes.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Yes, the ruling referred to acts done after הפרשה, like רב המנונא.

steps.title: רבין's three-part summary
steps.stepSummary: רבין opens a summary: two cases where everyone agrees and one case that is disputed, all about שפחה חרופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: When רבין came, he said: Everyone agrees about a שפחה חרופה, and everyone agrees about a שפחה חרופה, and there is a dispute about a שפחה חרופה.
steps.whatsHappening: This line sets up the next move. רבין lists three headings, and the גמרא will explain each one in the next steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Saying the same words three times is a memory device. It shows that the שפחה חרופה case divides into three different situations, each with its own outcome.
steps.confusionAlert: The three phrases look identical, but each refers to a different situation. The explanation of each comes in the following steps.

phrases.english: When Ravin came, he said:
Everyone agrees regarding a designated maidservant,
and everyone agrees regarding a designated maidservant,
and there is a dispute regarding a designated maidservant.

steps.triggerLanguage: כִּי אֲתָא רָבִין אָמַר הַכֹּל מוֹדִים בְּשִׁפְחָה חֲרוּפָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new report that organizes all the earlier opinions.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The שפחה חרופה case has two agreed outcomes and one disputed outcome.

steps.title: Agreed case one: only one offering, like עולא
steps.stepSummary: Everyone agrees that only one offering is brought in עולא's case.
steps.simpleTranslation: Everyone agrees about a שפחה חרופה that he is obligated in only one offering, as עולא said.
steps.whatsHappening: רבין explains his first heading. Under the view that an אשם does not need ידיעה בתחילה, everyone, including רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש, agrees that one offering covers all the acts.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Under this view, awareness has nothing to do with the אשם. So the dispute about whether awareness splits sins never comes up, and there is no room to argue.

phrases.english: Everyone agrees regarding a designated maidservant
that he is only obligated in one —
as Ulla said.

steps.triggerLanguage: הַכֹּל מוֹדִים בְּשִׁפְחָה חֲרוּפָה דְּאֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא אַחַת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the first heading of רבין's summary.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If an אשם does not require ידיעה, all agree that one offering covers multiple acts.

steps.title: Agreed case two: an offering for each act, like רב המנונא
steps.stepSummary: Everyone agrees that acts done after הפרשה each require their own offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: And everyone agrees about a שפחה חרופה that he is obligated for each and every act, as רב המנונא said.
steps.whatsHappening: רבין explains his second heading. When the acts happen after an animal was set aside, everyone agrees each one needs its own offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Setting aside an animal creates a clear break, no matter what view one holds about awareness. This is the point רב המנונא made and עולא accepted.

phrases.english: And everyone agrees regarding a designated maidservant
that he is obligated for each and every one —
as Rav Hamnuna said.
phrases.notes: Acts done after setting aside the animal.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהַכֹּל מוֹדִים בְּשִׁפְחָה חֲרוּפָה דְּחַיָּיב עַל כׇּל אַחַת וְאַחַת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the second heading of רבין's summary.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Acts done after הפרשה each require a separate offering, according to all.

steps.title: The disputed case: the רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש argument
steps.stepSummary: If an אשם ודאי requires ידיעה בתחילה, the question of multiple acts depends on the dispute between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש.
steps.simpleTranslation: And there is a dispute about a שפחה חרופה: according to the one who says an אשם ודאי requires ידיעה בתחילה, it is the dispute between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש.
steps.whatsHappening: רבין explains his third heading. Under the view that an אשם requires awareness, the אשם is treated like a חטאת, so it falls into the same argument.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This matches אביי's challenge to רב דימי. Under this view there is no agreed answer. It depends on whether awareness between sins splits them, which is exactly what רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש argue about.

keyTerms.meaning: רבי שמעון בן לקיש, רבי יוחנן's study partner and frequent disputant

steps.whatToRemember: There are three situations. (1) If an אשם does not need ידיעה, everyone agrees on one offering, like עולא. (2) Acts done after הפרשה require an offering for each act according to everyone, like רב המנונא. (3) If an אשם does need ידיעה, it depends on the dispute between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש.

phrases.english: And the dispute regarding a designated maidservant —
according to the one who says that a definite guilt-offering
requires awareness at the start,

phrases.aramaic: מַחֲלוֹקֶת דְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן לָקִישׁ.
phrases.english: is the dispute of Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמַחְלוֹקֶת בְּשִׁפְחָה חֲרוּפָה לְמַאן דְּאָמַר אָשָׁם וַדַּאי בָּעֵי יְדִיעָה בַּתְּחִלָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the third heading and completes רבין's summary.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Under the view that an אשם requires ידיעה, the number of offerings for multiple acts depends on the dispute between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש.

steps.title: Introduction to a new dispute
steps.stepSummary: The word איתמר opens a new discussion that continues on the next amud.
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. The גמרא is about to quote a dispute between אמוראים, and the content comes on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: איתמר tells us a disagreement between אמוראים is coming. Nothing has been said yet. This line only opens the next topic.

keyTerms.meaning: It was stated (introduces a dispute between אמוראים)

phrases.english: It was stated:

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Transition to a new topic after רבין's summary.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Introduces an upcoming dispute between אמוראים (content on the next amud).
